name: rw-aur
label: RW Aurigae
method: aperture photometry r=2 px, sky ring 4-7 px; Gaia neighbours within 15" fitted together
note: 323 measurements, one per SPHEREx photo; 305 flagged (302 overloaded: the star is too bright for the camera there); 116 measure only the glow around an overloaded core (shows changes, not total brightness); error bars widened x29.0 to match the real scatter.

variability.text: inconclusive: the star overloads the camera in 302 of 323 photos, so the few usable ones cannot show a reliable change
